What we do

Specialized wallcovering services.

JV Wallpaper focuses on the details that matter: proper preparation, careful layout, clean installation, and respect for the finished space.

01

Wallpaper Installation

Professional installation of traditional, designer, and specialty wallcoverings.

02

Preparation & Priming

Wall preparation and wallpaper-specific priming to create the right surface before installation.

03

Removal

Careful removal of existing wallpaper and preparation for a new finish.

04

Grasscloth & Natural

Thoughtful layout and handling for natural materials where seams and panel variation are part of the finished look.

05

Murals & Custom

Panel murals, custom prints, landscape scenes, and other specialty wallcoverings.

06

Ceilings & Details

Ceilings, built-ins, cubbies, cabinet interiors, accent areas, and architectural details.

How it works

Easy for the client. Controlled by you.

Customers can request a time online, but nothing becomes official until JV Wallpaper approves the appointment.
